answers.question: What should happen if an owner sets an expiry at or before the current time on a link that has not yet expired?
answers.answer: Reject it with 400 and error code invalid_expiry (expiresAt must be in the future), exactly as link creation does, and leave the link unchanged. An owner who wants a link gone deletes it. This keeps one expiry rule everywhere and prevents an irreversible accidental expiry.
